item.title: Apokries, Meatfare Sunday
item.description: Today the Greek Orthodox Church commemorates Apokries, Meatfare Sunday, which is the last day of meat consumption until Pascha. The Sunday of the Last Judgment or Meatfare Sunday is the third Sunday using the Lenten Triodion, the liturgical book used in the services of Great Lent. item.title: AI to Power Greece’s Achilles’ Shield
item.description: Greece is in advanced talks with Israel to integrate artificial intelligence into the planned Achilles’ Shield air defense system. The AI software will automatically detect, classify and select the optimal interception method against incoming threats, enhancing efficiency, conserving resources and strengthening national air defense capabilities.
